activities.title: Choose your distance
activities.description: Look at a stationary robot from a distance you choose, or decline.

activities.title: Notice one detail
activities.description: Choose something to notice. There is no need to approach or touch.

activities.title: Pause away from the activity
activities.description: Take a break in a space of your choice.

activities.title: Close the session
activities.description: Choose whether to share a thought or simply finish.
